item.title: What Reverend Jesse Jackson Means To Me And The Still Unfinished Movement
item.description: Rev. Jackson taught us that progress happens because people organize, apply pressure, and refuse to accept second-class citizenship as permanent.

item.title: DHS Spokeswoman Tricia McLaughlin Is Out As MAGA Turmoil Continues
item.description: Tricia McLaughlin's departure comes at a time when DHS is suffering from a PR nightmare following very high-profile shootings involving ICE.

item.title: Notable Black Folks Who Died In 2026

item.title: Florida Rep. Randy Fine Says He Prefers Dogs To Muslims, Now Faces Calls For His Resignation
item.description: In a post on X, Randy Fine wrote, "If they force us to choose, the choice between dogs and Muslims is not a difficult one."

item.title: Judge Declares Mistrial In Case Against Texas Anti-ICE Protesters Trump Administration Said Were Antifa
item.description: The judge in the case objected to a shirt worn by one of the defense attorneys which contained images of Civil Rights Movement leaders.

item.title: Trump Celebrates Black History Month By Calling On Black MAGA To Sing His Praises
item.description: On Wednesday, Donald Trump invited his Black MAGA friends to the East Room at the White House so they could tell everyone how cool he is.

item.title: Arrest Made In Case Of Black USPS Mail Carrier Gunned Down In Dekalb County
item.description: Dequavious "Quay" Graves was gunned down Feb. 12 while delivering mail on his postal route in Dekalb County, Georgia.

item.title: Everything We Know About The Potomac Sewage Spill
item.description: The Potomac Interceptor pipeline broke in January, spilling millions of gallons of wastewater during the first five days of the spill.

item.title: 21-Year-Old’s Body Found In Wooded Area Of Georgia Park, Authorities Are Investigating It As A Suicide
item.description: The unidentified 21-year-old man was found on February 14 in Fair Oaks Park in Marietta, Georgia, northwest of the city of Atlanta.

item.title: Judge Gives Trump Administration Until Friday To Restore Slavery Exhibit
item.description: Over the last year, the Trump administration has made a concerted effort to remove Black history exhibits from national parks and monuments.
